name: Pipedrive
label: Pipedrive REST v1/v2 — deals, people, orgs, activities, leads
description: Official Pipedrive REST: v2 for deals/persons/orgs/activities/products/search (v1 twins of those are out of support since 2026-08-01). v1 remains the official surface for notes, files, and leads (no v2). Handler: OfficialApiNode. Base https://api.pipedrive.com. Auth: OAuth Bearer access_token minted outside StudioQuack. Inbound webhooks require OAuth scope webhooks:full. Customer owns the Pipedrive company. CRM records are PII. Never log tokens or note HTML. Inbound webhooks: selecting the :listen operation (trigger.listen) via webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef) blocks the canvas INPUT port and compiles as a webhook-triggered Message Start (or binds to any Activity's MESSAGE Boundary Event).
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. Do not put secrets here. Example keys match api_spec.json required/queryFrom/bodyFrom.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Overrides config operation when non-blank. EXACT: activity.create | activity.get | activity.list | activity.update | activity.delete | deal.create | deal.get | deal.list | deal.search | deal.update | deal.delete | deal.duplicate | deal.activity.list | dealProduct.add | dealProduct.list | dealProduct.update | dealProduct.remove | person.create | person.get | person.list | person.search | person.update | person.delete | org.create | org.get | org.list | org.search | org.update | org.delete | lead.create | lead.get | lead.list | lead.update | lead.delete | note.create | note.get | note.list | note.update | note.delete | file.create | file.get | file.download | file.delete | product.list | trigger.listen. trigger.listen (:listen role) is configured on the node via webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef) for inbound webhooks (blocks the canvas INPUT port).

schema.label: id
schema.description: Entity id for get/update/delete and deal-scoped product/file paths.

schema.label: fields
schema.description: Escape hatch: custom-field hashes merged at the JSON root (bodyMap $) on activity/deal/person/org/lead/note create and update. Named keys (title, name, …) win on conflict. Official v2 custom fields belong in custom_fields. Example: {"hash40":"value"}.

schema.label: subject
schema.description: Activity subject for activity.create and activity.update. Example: Follow-up call.

schema.label: type
schema.description: Activity type key for activity.create/update. EXACT common: call | meeting | task | deadline | email | lunch. Custom types allowed. Example: call.

schema.label: title
schema.description: Deal or lead title. Required on deal.create and lead.create. Example: Q4 renewal.

schema.label: name
schema.description: Person or organization name. Required on person.create and org.create. Example: Ada Lovelace.

schema.label: content
schema.description:
Note HTML for note.create (required) and note.update. Example:

Intro call notes

. Never log.

schema.label: owner_id
schema.description: Owner user id for create/update of activity, deal, person, org, lead; also list filters. Example: 1.

schema.label: lead_id
schema.description: Lead uuid. activity.create/update and note.create/update body; activity.list / note.list filter. Example: 1d2f3e4a-....

schema.label: project_id
schema.description: Project id on activity.create/update and note.create/update. Example: 9.

schema.label: task_id
schema.description: Task id on note.create/update. Example: 3.

schema.label: user_id
schema.description: Note author user id (admin only) on note.create/update. Example: 1.

schema.label: pipeline_id
schema.description: Deal pipeline id for deal.create/update. Example: 1.

schema.label: stage_id
schema.description: Deal stage id for deal.create/update. Example: 2.

schema.label: value
schema.description: Deal monetary value (number) on deal.create/update, or lead value object {amount, currency} on lead.create/update. Example deal: 15000. Example lead: {"amount":15000,"currency":"USD"}.

schema.label: currency
schema.description: ISO 4217 currency for deal.create/update when value is a number. Example: USD.

schema.label: status
schema.description: Deal status for deal.create/update and deal.list filter. EXACT: open | won | lost | deleted. Example: open.

schema.label: probability
schema.description: Deal win probability 0–100 on deal.create/update. Example: 40.

schema.label: lost_reason
schema.description: Reason when deal status is lost. deal.create/update. Example: Budget.

schema.label: visible_to
schema.description: Visibility. v2 deals/persons/orgs: integer 1|3|5|7. v1 leads: string "1"|"3"|"5"|"7". 1=owner, 3=group, 7=entire company. Example: 3.

schema.label: expected_close_date
schema.description: Expected close date YYYY-MM-DD for deal.create/update and lead.create/update. Example: 2026-12-31.

schema.label: label_ids
schema.description: Label ids for deal/person/org/lead create and update. JSON array of integers (or lead-label uuids). Example: [1,2].

schema.label: custom_fields
schema.description: Official v2 custom-field map keyed by 40-char hash. deal/person/org create and update. Clear with null (not []). Example: {"0123…abcd":"Enterprise"}.

schema.label: emails
schema.description: Person emails for person.create/update. [{value, primary, label}]. label: work|home|mobile|other. Example: [{"value":"ada@example.com","primary":true,"label":"work"}].

schema.label: phones
schema.description: Person phones for person.create/update. [{value, primary, label}]. Example: [{"value":"+1-202-555-0100","primary":true,"label":"work"}].

schema.label: marketing_status
schema.description: Person marketing status when Campaigns is enabled. EXACT: no_consent | unsubscribed | subscribed | archived. person.create/update. Example: subscribed.

schema.label: organization_id
schema.description: Lead organization id (v1 name; not org_id) for lead.create/update. Required on create unless person_id is set. Example: 45.

schema.label: was_seen
schema.description: Whether the lead was seen in the UI. lead.create/update. Example: false.

schema.label: origin_id
schema.description: Optional origin discriminator for lead.create/update. Example: inbound-form.

schema.label: channel
schema.description: Marketing channel id from deal fields. lead.create/update. Example: 1.

schema.label: channel_id
schema.description: Optional channel discriminator. lead.create/update. Example: newsletter-oct.

schema.label: due_date
schema.description: Activity due date YYYY-MM-DD. activity.create/update. Example: 2026-11-04.

schema.label: due_time
schema.description: Activity due time HH:MM (24h). activity.create/update. Example: 14:30.

schema.label: duration
schema.description: Activity duration HH:MM. activity.create/update. Example: 01:00.

schema.label: busy
schema.description: Mark assignee busy on the calendar. activity.create/update. Example: true.

schema.label: done
schema.description: Activity done flag; also activity.list filter. Example: false.

schema.label: location
schema.description: Activity location {value, country, locality, …}. activity.create/update. Example: {"value":"1 Market St, San Francisco"}.

schema.label: participants
schema.description: Activity participants. Use [{person_id, primary:true}] to link a person (v2 does not accept person_id on the activity). activity.create/update. Example: [{"person_id":123,"primary":true}].

schema.label: attendees
schema.description: Activity attendees [{email, name, status, is_organizer, person_id, user_id}]. activity.create/update.

schema.label: public_description
schema.description: Public activity description. activity.create/update.

schema.label: priority
schema.description: Activity priority id from activity fields. activity.create/update. Example: 1.

schema.label: outcome
schema.description: Activity outcome id from activity fields. activity.create/update. Example: 2.

schema.label: note
schema.description: Activity note (not the Notes API). activity.create/update. Example: Asked for a proposal.

schema.label: address
schema.description: Organization address {value, country, locality, postal_code, …}. org.create/update. Example: {"value":"1 Market St"}.

schema.label: website
schema.description: Organization website. org.create/update. Example: https://example.com.

schema.label: linkedin
schema.description: Organization LinkedIn URL. org.create/update.

schema.label: industry
schema.description: Organization industry id. org.create/update. Example: 1.

schema.label: annual_revenue
schema.description: Organization annual revenue. org.create/update. Example: 5000000.

schema.label: employee_count
schema.description: Organization employee count. org.create/update. Example: 120.

schema.label: pinned_to_deal_flag
schema.description: Pin note to deal. 0 or 1. note.create/update. Requires deal_id.

schema.label: pinned_to_person_flag
schema.description: Pin note to person. 0 or 1. note.create/update. Requires person_id.

schema.label: pinned_to_organization_flag
schema.description: Pin note to org. 0 or 1. note.create/update. Requires org_id.

schema.label: pinned_to_lead_flag
schema.description: Pin note to lead. 0 or 1. note.create/update. Requires lead_id.

schema.label: filter_id
schema.description: Saved filter id for activity/deal/person/org list. Example: 12.

schema.label: sort_by
schema.description: List sort field. Activities: id|update_time|add_time|due_date. Deals/persons/orgs: id|update_time|add_time. Example: update_time.

schema.label: sort_direction
schema.description: List sort direction. EXACT: asc | desc. Example: desc.

schema.label: start
schema.description: v1 pagination offset for lead.list and note.list. Example: 0.

schema.label: discount
schema.description: Deal-product discount percent for dealProduct.add/update. Example: 10.

schema.label: comments
schema.description: Deal-product comments for dealProduct.add/update.

schema.label: tax
schema.description: Deal-product tax percent for dealProduct.add. Example: 8.5.

schema.label: term
schema.description: Search term for deal/person/org search.

schema.label: limit
schema.description: Page size; cap 500.

schema.label: cursor
schema.description: v2 pagination cursor.

schema.label: deal_id
schema.description: Deal id. activity.create/update and note.create/update body; activity.list / note.list / deal.activity.list filter. Example: 88.

schema.label: person_id
schema.description: Person id. deal.create/update and lead.create/update body; note.create/update and file.create association; activity.list / note.list / deal.search filter. Activity person link uses participants, not this field. Example: 123.

schema.label: org_id
schema.description: Organization id. deal/person/activity/note create-update body and list filters. Example: 45.

schema.label: activity_id
schema.description: file.create association.

schema.label: product_id
schema.description: dealProduct.add product id.

schema.label: product_attachment_id
schema.description: dealProduct.update/remove attachment id.

schema.label: item_price
schema.description: Deal product line price.

schema.label: quantity
schema.description: Deal product quantity.

schema.label: file
schema.description: file.create platform file ref-id. Never inline bytes. OfficialApiNode JSON body cannot do true multipart — see README.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: status=ok, http_status, data (provider JSON). Inbound webhook events (:listen) emit normalized event data on output. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: status
schema.description: Exact 'ok' on HTTP 2xx.

schema.label: http_status
schema.description: Upstream status code.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Provider JSON. Size-capped. Never log secrets or raw PII.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when input.operation is blank. EXACT: activity.create | activity.get | activity.list | activity.update | activity.delete | deal.create | deal.get | deal.list | deal.search | deal.update | deal.delete | deal.duplicate | deal.activity.list | dealProduct.add | dealProduct.list | dealProduct.update | dealProduct.remove | person.create | person.get | person.list | person.search | person.update | person.delete | org.create | org.get | org.list | org.search | org.update | org.delete | lead.create | lead.get | lead.list | lead.update | lead.delete | note.create | note.get | note.list | note.update | note.delete | file.create | file.get | file.download | file.delete | product.list | trigger.listen. Selecting trigger.listen (:listen role) reveals webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef), blocks the canvas INPUT port, and compiles as a webhook-triggered Message Start or Activity MESSAGE Boundary Event.

configurationParameters.label: Access token
configurationParameters.description: OAuth access token minted outside StudioQuack (StudioQuack secret). Authorization: Bearer. Marketplace apps. webhooks:full required for trigger.listen. Never on INPUT. Never log.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Per-request HTTP timeout. Positive number; <=0 → 30. Keep below the daemon invoke budget.

configurationParameters.label: Webhook Key
configurationParameters.description: Engine Webhook API Key binding ($webhookKeyRef) routing inbound HTTP webhooks to this node.
